C_D.note: C must not conflate delay dynamics with wave inference or H4 topology rescue.

C_W.name: wave_inference
C_W.deliverable: estimator producing W_hat from Phi or appropriately structured X/Q

C_F.name: field_feedback
C_F.note: Ephaptic / field-to-neuron feedback is explicitly excluded from 0.4.17-C.

causal_hierarchy.rule: Nothing computed by the estimator may feed upstream into S, F, emitters, or simulate state.

operational_wave_definition.statement: A traveling wave requires preregistered band-limited phase structure with spatially coherent phase gradient exceeding null thresholds; pairwise phase differences alone are insufficient.

classification_labels.TRAVELING_WAVE: Preregistered gates passed; planar phase-gradient fit exceeds coherence and R2 thresholds with identifiable k and v_phase.
classification_labels.NO_WAVE: Valid negative outcome: input fails wave gates under frozen thresholds (e.g. k=0 synchronous, random phase, noise-only).
classification_labels.UNRESOLVED: Estimator identifiability or data quality insufficient; must not be collapsed into NO_WAVE (W3b lesson: unresolved is not negative).

estimator_output_contract.display_box: (classification, f, k, v_phase, R2_phase, coherence, uncertainty/null score)

preregistered_estimator_parameters.velocity_convention: v_phase = omega / |k| with omega = 2*pi*f_fit and k from spatial gradient

negative_controls.model: band-limited noise with random phase per channel

synthetic_controls.false_positive_priority: Negative-control specificity outweighs positive-example visual impressiveness.

checkpoints.C0: Wave protocol specification (this document); no estimator implementation
checkpoints.C1: Estimator validation on synthetic fields only
checkpoints.C2: General Model.simulate delay_state continuation (Protocol D/H2 semantics; zero-delay unchanged)
checkpoints.C3: Prospective neural geometry/delay experiment; acceptance does not require waves
checkpoints.C4: Frozen receipt and publication interpretation before Figure 5 use

C2_delay_continuation_requirements.required_equivalence: segmented vs uninterrupted continuation matches on X, H, delay_state (B_t), and other declared recurrence state
C2_delay_continuation_requirements.zero_delay_regression: delay_steps=0 embeds legacy instantaneous kernel (Protocol D0)

experiment_a_integration.note: Experiment A (40-neuron seed 7) answers operator factorization; Protocol C answers wave inference under frozen geometry/delay conditions.
